title: Amanda Holley Drops New Single "SEASONING"
htmlContent:
Amanda Holley, a multi-racial 5-octave singer-songwriter and Grammy Recording Academy Member has released a compelling R&B/Pop anthem called "SEASONING." The track, produced by Grammy-winning producer and artist Andre "GC" Fennell, encompasses traditional soul elements and modern urban pop beats.

The collaboration with co-writers Grammy-winning Andre "GC" Fennell and Emmillienne Bellaire resulted in a soulful, spicy, and rhythmic R&B pop anthem. According to Holley, the song represents the connection between seasoning and soul, as both transcend cultures and generations, serving as catalysts for love and art.

In addition to her singing and songwriting, Amanda Holley is a self-taught musician who has been playing piano and violin since age two. She has performed at prestigious venues and events such as Fashion Week in NY & LA, the United Nations, Coachella, Carnegie Hall, W Times Square NYC, W Hollywood, the Pacific Design Center, and Sony Hall NYC. Her poetic voice, recognized and published by Columbia Press during her teen years, has been featured in multiple motion picture soundtracks.

Her impactful and immersive music reflects her passion and talent as an artist, inviting listeners to savor a rich musical experience with "SEASONING."
